headline: Amazon to Hire Over 300,000 Workers for Holiday Season
summary: Amazon plans to hire over 300,000 workers for the holiday season, up 20% from 2025, with temporary workers earning an average of $20 per hour.
why: Amazon is the world's largest e-commerce retailer, and its seasonal hiring targets serve as a barometer for retail labor demand ahead of the holidays.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Expanded seasonal staffing indicates strong anticipated delivery and fulfillment volumes.
